name: meeting_capture
description: Pro-tier meeting capture: speaker diarization + calendar-aware stitching + LLM meeting summary. Plain (community) audio transcription lives in plugins/voice_memos.

WHISPER_MODEL.description: Whisper model size: tiny|base|small|medium|large-v3 (default medium for quality/speed balance)

WHISPER_LANGUAGE.description: Force a specific language ISO code, or 'auto' for detection

DIARIZATION_MIN_SPEAKERS.description: Lower bound for pyannote speaker count detection. Tighter bound improves accuracy.

DIARIZATION_MAX_SPEAKERS.description: Upper bound. When calendar attendee count is known via calendar_stitching, this is overridden per-meeting.

HF_TOKEN_REQUIRED.description: Hugging Face access token required for pyannote model weights. Set via Cerid TCC wizard → onboarding step.

CALENDAR_STITCH_WINDOW_SECONDS.description: How much overlap between recording timestamp and calendar event window counts as a match.
